sentences.text: Two further Oribacterium species were described from strictly anaerobic, Gram-positive, non-spore-forming, motile rods isolated from human subgingival dental plaque.
Those strains required yeast extract for growth, and acetate was a major fermentation end product.
A case-control study of children aged 6 to 17 years reported Oribacterium among genera discriminating the oral microbiota of children with obesity.
In a hamster experiment, oral administration of a pair of gut microbes including Oribacterium sp. GMB0313 was reported to provide protection in a COVID-19 model.
